room_tone.continuous: not reseated across the cut — same file, same level

entry_signature.audio: conch with a bell on its attack
entry_signature.rule: Shown ONLY on a standalone open — the first film of a session, or a share cut. Never between consecutive films.

landing.what: the final hold — 8s where something has landed, 4s where a sentence is unfinished
landing.rule: Never captioned. Never scored. The question-out is delivered as a FACT in-app, and may be spoken as a question only in a share cut.

hook.principle: The question-out of one film IS the question-in of the next, word for word. That identity is the chain and it is checked mechanically.
hook.in_app: The next film autoplays on the landing. The hook is structural, not stated.
hook.share_cut: The landing question may be SPOKEN aloud, once, as the last line.
never: cutting a film short to manufacture a cliffhanger — every film lands its own payoff
a question the source answers, staged as withheld
a card asking the question the film just posed

doors.what: Follow a character · ask the source · see the trail
doors.return: A detour returns you to the EXACT frame you left, at the exact timecode.
doors.rule: Doors appear only once the film has finished paying. They never interrupt.

differs_by: a connect line of minimum context, never the payoff
the landing hold shortened (proposed 5s) and dimmed 40%
the exit card over the dimmed frame
share_cut.never: share-to-unlock; the story is never gated behind a share

forbidden: fade to black between films in continuous play
